Episode 31: Dilruba’s Disguise
Dilruba, who is pretending to be Paro, gains the trust of Koki. Prema too fails to recognize Dilruba in his disguise. Later, a scuffle ensues between Koki and Dilruba and the disguise is finally revealed to Koki and Keshav. How will Prema react to Dilruba’s disguise? Watch and find out.
